content.text:
I found the problem and fixed it. `site/products.html` had the "Sunset Mug" card in it twice, so the product grid showed two identical cards and left an orphaned Citrus Plant Pot alone on the last row. I removed the duplicate.

The git history has only one commit, so I couldn't diff against "the last change". I found it by reading the HTML and rendering the page. I didn't re-render after the fix, so the layout isn't re-checked by eye. The page now has six products in two full rows of three, and the 16 functional tests pass.

The "New" and "Sale" badges overhang the card corners, but that comes from the CSS (`top: -10px; right: -10px`) and looks deliberate, so I left it.

STATUS: DONE
